## 10000 - 10012

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="10000">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />10000 AUDIT - Audits</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="10000">

This exception is a header exception. The exceptions in this group all pertain to audits.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="10001">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />10001 AUDIT - Missing monthly sales meter volume (30–59 days)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="10001">

This exception is only generated when an Audit is setup on a meter. The exception will be generated when the Audit/Sales meter is missing Volume data for 30-59 days. The Audit service will look at Final Form data to make this determination, so if the exception is being generated and there is relevant data, a common issue would be that the data is not rolled up by the Meter Rollup service.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="10004">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />10004 AUDIT - Missing monthly sales meter energy (30–59 days)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="10004">

This exception is only generated when an Audit is setup on a meter. The exception will be generated when the Audit/Sales meter is missing Energy data for 30-59 days. The Audit service will look at Final Form data to make this determination, so if the exception is being generated and there is relevant data, a common issue would be that the data is not rolled up by the Meter Rollup service. Another common issue may be that an analysis is not applied to the meter, and is preventing Energy from being calculated.

</div>
